newsitem.title: UK: Advanced Power Components makes LSE debut. [CORRECTED 12:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Advanced Power Components makes LSE debut. [CORRECTED 12:45 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline to read LSE debut rather than AIM debut)
Shares in Advanced Power Components Plc, a manufacturer and distributor of electronic components, set a premium on their first day of trading on London Stock Exchange on Thursday.

By 1151 GMT the shares were quoted at 75p in volumne of 677,546 shares. They were issued at 70p in an oversubscribed placing which valued the company at 16.0 million stg and raised 5.25 million stg. The proceeds will increase working capital and fund expansion.
The broker to the float was Henry Cooke Corporate.
